verdict.rationale: Obsidian's own docs describe the official Obsidian Web Clipper, a free browser extension that highlights pages and saves web content straight to the vault. It also supports custom templates for specific websites. Missing for 10: deeper documentation of article extraction and highlight capture behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the clipper.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can clip web pages, articles, and highlights from my browser straight into my notes with an official clipper or capture flow

citations.quote: Obsidian Web Clipper is a free browser extension that lets you highlight pages and save web content to your vault.
Templates - Create custom templates for specific websites.
